title: Inspect-Before-Edit Seam QA & Adversarial Diff Verification

claims.assertion: Premature file modification without inspect-before-edit protocols results in broken module seams and cascading regressions.
Authoring test contracts before editing and evaluating git diffs with strict 1-10 severity reviews prevents hallucinated fixes.
Component seam analysis (Michael Feathers seams) maps data models, routes, and transaction boundaries prior to refactoring.

context: Knowledge item ki_self_20260828_03: Inspect-Before-Edit Seam QA & Adversarial Diff Verification
distilled_learning:
### Distilled Heuristic
Agents must never prematurely modify code without first mapping DAG component seams, authoring failing test contracts, and validating changes against strict git diffs.
